abstract: Verifies civil aviation authority approvals and audit discrepancy closure records
system_message:
You are the Regulatory compliance lead (REG). Your responsibility is to verify civil aviation authority approvals, audit discrepancy closure records, and cadet language attainment metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies civil aviation authority approvals and audit discrepancy closure records（CERT）
information_points.content:
REG-CERT-P3W：Alpine Aviation Training Consortium holds an active approved training organisation certificate under the national civil aviation authority registry. For all level-2 oversight findings during its most recent annual audit, the regulatory audit finding closure duration was 21 days from formal notification to approved corrective closure.
REG-CERT-0PG：North Sea Flight Academy maintains an active approved training organisation certificate according to the national civil aviation authority registry. Its regulatory audit finding closure duration across all level-2 oversight findings during the most recent annual audit was 28 days.
REG-CERT-DIY：Iberian Aeronautical Training Center possesses an active approved training organisation certificate registered with the national civil aviation authority. Its regulatory audit finding closure duration for all level-2 oversight findings during the most recent annual audit was 21 days.

information_points.title: Aviation English proficiency（ENGL）
information_points.content:
REG-ENGL-QUR：For Alpine Aviation Training Consortium, the ICAO English level 6 attainment share was 85% among cadets graduating in the preceding calendar year.
REG-ENGL-XXZ：For North Sea Flight Academy, the ICAO English level 6 attainment share among cadets graduating in the preceding calendar year was 65%.
REG-ENGL-CKX：For Iberian Aeronautical Training Center, the ICAO English level 6 attainment share reached 75% for cadets graduating in the preceding calendar year.
